text:
maria_g: Quick ops thread — finalizing Zoom RTMP fallback + asset-split plan for Thu benchmark webinar. Need confirmations on: RTMP backup target, local recording retention, clip splits and S3 path, and post-event lead routing. Goal: <24h assets + seed nurture.

sam_dev: I can take RTMP fallback. Plan: primary Zoom cloud recording + RTMP to stream.live/redwood-prod as backup. If cloud recording fails, RTMP > livestream-worker will capture HLS. Will add healthcheck.

olivia_ops: Do we have region-specific RTMP endpoints? We should avoid cross-region egress for EU attendees.

sam_dev: Proposed endpoints: us-west.rtmp.redwood.stream, eu-central.rtmp.redwood.stream. Added in the Zoom Advanced > Streaming page. I'll post the exact settings.

sam_dev: ```
RTMP URL: rtmp://eu-central.rtmp.redwood.stream/live
Key: webinar-thu-rtmp-eu
```

chris_marketing: For clip splits — we want 5 clips: intro (0-3m), demo-clip (12-20m), benchmark-results (28-36m), q&a-snippets (45-60m), call-to-action (last 90s). Can ops tag timestamps or should we auto-split by silence?

olivia_ops: We'll do automatic silence-based segments + fixed markers. I'll add a postproc job that runs ffmpeg trim + normalize. Upload target s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-27-benchmark/

zach_sales: Lead routing: can we mark attendees who asked Qs and push to SFDC as 'high interest'? Also include recording_view link in CRM note.

chris_marketing: Yes. We'll add UTMs to replay link. Also send follow-up: 0h thank-you with replay (clips + full), 24h nurture with benchmark highlights, 7d CTA email.

zoom-bot: Recording scheduled: cloud recording enabled, auto-transcribe ON. Backup streaming target set: us-west & eu-central RTMP endpoints. Recording ID: rec_1891239876

maria_g: Ops checklist before start: 1) Verify RTMP keys in Zoom account 2) Confirm s3 write creds for postproc 3) QA host/alt host with bak camera flow 4) Test clip-split pipeline on small sample. Sam, Olivia can you confirm by EOD?

sam_dev: Confirmed. I'll run a 5-min test at 16:00PT and post logs.

olivia_ops: Confirmed. I'll provision temporary S3 creds and share secure link.

sam_dev: Test log: SUCCESS. Cloud recording + RTMP -> ingest passed. ffmpeg split job created and uploaded to s3. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/1891239876/test-rtmp (internal).

chris_marketing: Thanks. For post-event: who owns the captions/timestamps QC?

maria_g: Chris to own QC + initial clips. Olivia to hand over final assets to chris. Zach will get SFDC list + replay link.

zach_sales: I'll annotate SFDC: set Lead.Score += 10 for attendees with Q tag; push to 'AE Follow-up' queue.

maria_g: Final note: if cloud recording corrupted, fallback policy is to promote RTMP HLS archive as canonical artifact and flag for manual QC. Also keep raw recordings for 30 days.

sam_dev: adding alert: if not all 5 clips ready within 12h, incident to #marketing-alerts with owner tag.

maria_g: Perfect. Thanks team :raised_hands: I'll update the runbook and post the final Zoom settings in #marketing pinned messages.
